selected_visualizations.title: Goal Timeline
selected_visualizations.reason: Every goal in order with the running scoreline.
selected_visualizations.best_for: Matches where the scoreline itself is the story.
selected_visualizations.avoid_when: One-goal games, where a single tactical pattern says more.

selected_visualizations.title: Shot Map
selected_visualizations.reason: Where both teams shot from and what happened to each attempt.
selected_visualizations.best_for: Volume mismatches, wasteful finishing, or a goal glut.
selected_visualizations.avoid_when: Too few shots to fill the pitch.

selected_visualizations.title: Momentum Swing
selected_visualizations.reason: Attacking pressure per five minutes, so the turning point is visible.
selected_visualizations.best_for: Comebacks, late sieges, and games that changed character.
selected_visualizations.avoid_when: The curve is flat and no swing actually happened.

all_candidates.best_for: Comebacks, late sieges, and games that changed character.
all_candidates.avoid_when: The curve is flat and no swing actually happened.

all_candidates.title: Territory Map
all_candidates.reason: Touch volume across eighteen zones shows who owned which areas.
all_candidates.best_for: Territorial stories where one side was pinned back.
all_candidates.avoid_when: Territory was even and the scoreline was not.

all_candidates.title: Goal Build-up
all_candidates.reason: One verified possession traced pass by pass to the finish.
all_candidates.best_for: A single constructed goal worth slowing down for.
all_candidates.avoid_when: High-scoring games, where one chain cannot carry the story.

all_candidates.title: Goalmouth Placement
all_candidates.reason: Where every on-target shot crossed the goal line, and who stopped it.

all_candidates.title: Pass Network
all_candidates.reason: Average positions and the strongest passing links.
all_candidates.avoid_when: Goals and shots explain the result more directly.

all_candidates.title: Control vs Threat
all_candidates.reason: Tests whether the team with the ball turned it into shots.
all_candidates.best_for: One-sided pass share that did not become chances.

scenes.title: PSG FOUND A WAY
scenes.insight: 6 shots on target turned into the win.
scenes.narration: PSG 2, Aston Villa 1. 6 shots on target turned into the win.

scenes.title: THE NUMBERS SPLIT DOWN THE MIDDLE
scenes.insight: Neither side could claim the baseline counts.
scenes.narration: Start with the baseline. Neither side could claim the baseline counts. Pass share was 59 to 41.

scenes.title: 3 GOALS, ONE RUNNING SCORE
scenes.insight: PSG had the last word in the 60th minute.
scenes.narration: Kvaratskhelia opened it in the 19th minute. 3 goals later it finished 2-1, Doué having the final say in the 60th.

scenes.title: PSG KEPT TESTING THE KEEPER
scenes.subtitle: Every attempt, by outcome
scenes.narration: PSG took 12 shots and put 6 on target. Aston Villa took 15 and hit the target 4 times. Blocked efforts are marked separately, because a block is not a save.

scenes.title: THE FIRST HALF SET THE TONE
scenes.subtitle: PSG above the line, Aston Villa below
scenes.insight: The heaviest spell fell to Aston Villa between minutes 40-44.
scenes.narration: This is attacking pressure in five minute blocks, built from final-third passes, box entries, shots and goals. The biggest surge belongs to Aston Villa in the 40-44 minute window.

scenes.title: PSG 2-1 ASTON VILLA
scenes.insight: PSG took the result and the numbers.
scenes.narration: PSG win it 2-1. 6 shots on target, 3 big chances, and a result that matches the map.
